# name: # commit HEAD means the commit the harness itself is checked out at.
# batch2_* are the scores in benchmarks/batch-2.md (anchors only); they calibrate c.
# state_signal=1 means the target prints a State line on SIGUSR1 (anchors die on it).
# fd_cap caps the extrapolation for a target that keeps every connection open
# (no Connection: close, no eviction): batch 2 shows such servers holding 71,000.
# go-loop-kodflow has none: its connections are io_uring direct descriptors
# (IORING_FILE_INDEX_ALLOC, IOSQE_FIXED_FILE) across three rings, 196,605
# slots, which take no process descriptor, so LimitNOFILE=65535 does not
# bound them; the official harness has no fd cap either (README.md, Scoring).
# The steps it held are in BENCH.md, S12: 120,000 held, 140,000 once in six.
# tree names the prepared build a row runs; a variant row shares its base's
# tree and differs only by env (space-separated K=V, or -).
# go-loop-kodflow runs as shipped: GOMAXPROCS one above the CPUs, which the
# binary sets itself, and the SDK's LoopsAuto (one loop per P but one);
# go-loop-kodflow-gmp2 names GOMAXPROCS=2 explicitly, the same setting on the
# 1-vCPU box, so it replicates it.
# go-loop-kodflow-bw<d> bound the SDK's grouped io_uring wait at <d>
# (LOOP_BATCH_WAIT); go-loop-kodflow ships 4 ms since S13, -bw250us is the
# SDK's own default. Since
# ADR 0202 the wait groups when two receives are expected within the bound,
# so at about 1,000 requests a second it starts from 1-2 ms (S13).
# go-loop-kodflow-r1* run one ring (MAX_CONNS=65000) instead of three, to
# tell the grouped wait's effect from the rings' cost (S12: 6.9 µs/req);
# S13 measured -r1 at 250 µs, before the default moved to 4 ms.
# go-loop-kodflow-noinc switches off the SDK's incremental provided-buffer
# consumption (IOU_PBUF_RING_INC, on by default since SDK #798), for S20.
# go-loop-kodflow-nobundle switched off the receive bundles (uring-recv-bundle,
# SDK #800) the S21 build opted into; the submission no longer opts in, so
# it now runs the same configuration as go-loop-kodflow.
